narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Green Iron Boots, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: At last! I've been stomping around the wetlands with soggy feet for days! Hopefully these aren't prone to rusting either. I trust you know what you're doing.
narrative.requestItemsText: Please tell me you're the one with the boots...
